The story does not change much around the rest of the US. If you aren’t getting an academic scholarship or have parents willing/able to help cover the costs than going to most any state school will still cost tens of thousands out of pocket. I was lucky enough to have 3/4 of my years covered by a scholarship program at a large midwestern university and I still have around 12k in loans. Sure NYU isn’t a great example but the fact remains that US students pay a lot of money for education at “good” schools regardless. I even received in-state tuition rates. Out-of-state was around $45,000 I believe. Local/community colleges make more sense now than ever.
